records.pickupSummary:
Kindly provide the name of your cruise ship when making your reservation. We require this information in advance to coordinate our representatives to meet you directly at your ship's gangway. Thank you for helping us ensure an effortless pickup experience.

Cruise ship pick-up Instructions:
Meeting Location: We know where your ship is! Go straight to the boardwalk/sidewalk directly in front of your ship - Includes AJ Dock (Do NOT go into town/tram or follow ship staff directions to leave the area).

Arrival Time: Arrive at least 15 minutes before your scheduled departure. Please keep your cell phone on you in case we need to get ahold of you.

️How to Find Us: Look for the representative, directly outside of your ships gangway, in bright orange with an orange flag in their backpack, holding an Alaska Galore Tours / Harv and Marv’s / Juneau Lighthouse Tours sign.

Accessibility & Assistance: You must be able to walk down a potentially steep tide ramp and step onto the bus and boat (foldable wheelchairs require advance notice).

Drop off point is the same as your pick up point. No other drop off locations can be accommodated. Any changes to your pick up location must be handled at least 24 hours in advance, and the tour provider must be contacted. 

If NOT arriving on a cruise ship, please contact us directly for options. We are happy to offer instructions on meeting us directly at our dock (Statter Harbor) or another central meeting location.

Please be sure to bring these instructions with you on the day of your tour!

records.cancellationSummary: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
records.pickupSummary:
*** This is an official product of Grupo Xcaret ***
1. For guests using Airbnb, a designated public meeting point has been allocated. Please write 'Plaza las Perlas' for Playa del Carmen on the address line. For Cancún, please write Base Xcaret. For Tulum, please write 'Aloft Tulum'. Please write 'Hotel Hacienda Morelos' when making a reservation for Puerto Morelos.
2. If your accommodation is not a hotel, you will need to enter your exact address including street name, street number, house number, county, postcode and city.
3. We can pick you up at your hotel or at the nearest available point on our routes.
4. To confirm your exact pick-up time and meeting point, please contact us at least 24 hours before your visit. From Monday to Friday, you may reach us through your reservation messages or by phone. On Saturdays and Sundays, our team is available by phone only to ensure a faster response and better assistance.
5. The guides will wear red T-shirts with the Xcaret logo on the back for easy identification. The guides will call out the name of the tour.
6. Upon pick up, please present your printed or digital voucher, photo ID and the credit card you used to make the purchase to board the bus and receive a wristband to enter the park.
7. You must arrive 15 minutes early at your assigned location.
Notes: 
a. Please let us know if you do not require transport.
b. We cannot guarantee to collect you from a hotel where you are not a guest, as some hotels have policies that do not allow visitors onto the premises.
c. If you do not have a hotel at the time you purchase your ticket, you must contact Viator Customer Service at least 24 hours prior to your park visit to coordinate your pickup with us.
d. Transportation is not private, so you will be sharing the bus with other visitors to Grupo Xcaret.
e. Depending on your hotel location, you should expect to spend between 30 minutes and an hour and a half travelling to the park.

Not suitable for infants or pets

We can make pick up at certain hotels piers (see the list). You only have to pay the pier taxes directly to your hotel. 

Our departure is at 9:30AM or 2:00 PM from downtown. Collections from any hotels will be after these times - anywhere between 15 and 45 minutes, depending on the distance from the hotel. Note: The locations we have available at the hotel docks are for the use of the guests of the above mentioned hotels only. 

Our primary meeting point is in downtown Cozumel, to the South side of the ferry terminal underneath the giant flagpole (approximately 2 minutes walk). One of our staff will be there, clearly marked with our branded clothing and signage, to welcome you. 

For clients arriving by cruise ship from the S.S.A and Puerta Maya terminals, please select the 'Cid la Ceiba' hotel as your departure point, which is a few minutes walk from the Puerta Maya terminal and the SSA terminal door. You will only pay a tax of $4 USD per passenger for use of this dock and we can gladly pick you up by boat. Our staff will meet you at the entrance of the hotel La Ceiba to accompany you to the catamaran, and assist you with paying the hotel.

records.pickupSummary:
Important Information
Please note: All tours operate on ship time, not local island time, unless otherwise stated. Our staff will be at the port from the time your ship docks and will be waiting for you at the designated meeting point.

Isla Tropicale – Carnival Port, Roatán
Pick-Up Instructions:
To meet our staff, you will walk approximately 2–5 minutes outside the terminal. If preferred, you may also take a taxi for $2 per person to the meeting point outside the port.
Our staff will be waiting with a sign that says “2K’s Adventures Tours.”
Pick-Up Time:
One hour after your ship arrives, or as soon as you are able to disembark and reach the meeting point.

Berth 1 – Port of Roatán
After leaving the ship, walk through the port past the shops and painted wall. Turn right down the aisle through the kiosk area offering independent tours. Follow the covered walkway and signs for “Port Offices,” “Taxi,” and “Exit.”
Continue straight through the pavilion area and exit through Gate 1 — the gate that leads to downtown.
Our team will be waiting right outside the gate with a sign that says “2K’s Adventures Tours.”

Guests Staying on the Island
We offer pick-up and drop-off service for guests staying at hotels, resorts, or Airbnbs. Please provide the name of your accommodation, and your driver will be there to pick you up at your selected time.

records.pickupSummary:
CRUISE PASSENGERS:
 • Pickup Location: We pick up directly from our booth at The Scooter ATV & Buggy Rental Center located within the Nassau Cruise Port.

⏰ CRITICAL TIMING POLICY (CRUISE):
 • To keep our tours running on time, the free Port shuttle pickup window is between 8:00 AM – 8:30 AM for the morning tour and 12:00 PM – 12:30 PM for the afternoon tour.

 • When you exit the ship, walk directly to the Scooter, ATV & Buggy Rental Center (a pink and white building located inside the main Nassau Cruise Port). Look directly for the C&C Scooter Rentals sign above our service window. Our port team will greet you and escort you to our private shuttle van for a quick 5-minute ride to our main vehicle compound to complete your check-in and safety tutorial briefing. We handle everything—including your guaranteed on-time shuttle return back to the port building at the end of your tour!

 HOTEL & RESORT GUESTS:
 • Pickup Location: Outside the Main lobby/valet entrance of your resort.
 • Action Required: Please reply with the Full Name of your Hotel.

⏰ CRITICAL TIMING POLICY (HOTEL):
 • To keep our tours running on time, hotel pickups begin 45 to 60 minutes before your official tour start time.
 • We will message you your exact 10-minute pickup window the evening before your tour.
 • Please note: Because our drivers serve multiple resorts, the van can only wait a maximum of 5 minutes outside your lobby before moving to the next stop. If you miss the shuttle because you were not in place, you will be responsible for getting to the tour activity starting point. There will be no refund!

 AIRBNB & PRIVATE RENTAL GUESTS:
 • Pickup Location: Directly at the front curb of your private Airbnb property.
 • Action Required: All Airbnb travelers must send a current location PIN via WhatsApp directly
 • ⚠️ IMPORTANT GPS INSTRUCTION: Please step completely outside and stand firmly in front of your Airbnb property on the main roadside while sending the location pin via WhatsApp. Do not send it from inside the house. This prevents the smartphone GPS network from glitching and accidentally sending our shuttle driver to a hidden backstreet or secondary lane.

⏰ CRITICAL TIMING POLICY (AIRBNB):
 • Pickups begin 45 to 60 minutes before your official tour start time.
 • Once we receive your current location pin, we will text-confirm your exact 5-minute pickup window. Please be waiting on the front curb when the shuttle van arrives.

If you prefer to meet us directly at the activities starting point, please let us know. The starting point coordinates are located on our listing for your convenience.

See you soon!
